source_co_endpoint.status: diagnostic co-endpoint reported for EVERY J row and seed that completes all six folds; never a gate, never used to select, never sufficient to promote

H_RF.name: representation-fixed source exclusion
H_RF.definition: for each of the 49 declared Stage H pairs, keep the J row's fine-tuned fold features fixed and refit the unchanged D1 downstream on (a) the base fold, (b) the source-ablated fold, (c) the three matched random removals. Uses EXACTLY the Stage H index sets saved in experiments/r2-compositional/v4/stage_h_20261114/D1_synthComp_norm/indexsets (sha256 in artifacts/r2/v4/stage_h_20261114/D1_synthComp_norm/indexsets_SHA256SUMS); each set is re-derived and must match.
H_RF.outcomes: the Stage H outcome set (novel-source seen Top-1, unseen Top-1 on source-s images, seen, unseen macro, H_bal, H_micro, AUSUC) at gamma 0 and at the row's pooled gamma; source and size effects; cluster bootstrap over sources (2,000 resamples, seed 0); reported next to D1's Stage H values
H_RF.limitation: the representation was trained WITH source s present, so H_RF measures downstream sensitivity and is expected to under-state the full source effect

H_RT.name: retrained source exclusion
H_RT.applies_to: only rows that pass the three-seed gate
H_RT.pair_rule: the three distinct sources with the most novel-source seen images among the 49 pairs (ties -> lower fold), from source_feasibility.json
H_RT.arms: retrain the row (seed 0) on the source-ablated fitting rows and on matched random control seed 0; base = the seed-0 fold model

execution.fitting_only: every optimisation step reads only the fold's fitting_rows. The image accessor refuses any row outside the phase's allowed set and any file not listed in the training CSV, and checks before opening. The extraction phase allows fitting, seen-val and unseen-val rows of the same fold, never outer rows; outer rows stay NaN.
execution.seeds: torch, numpy and the sampler generator are seeded with 1000*seed + fold_index; DataLoader workers get seed 1000*seed + fold_index + 100*worker; cudnn.benchmark off. GPU nondeterminism is not assumed away: reruns are compared, not presumed identical.
execution.checkpoints: per (row, seed, fold): the trainable parameters, heads and extra modules, plus a manifest (config sha256, weights sha256, sorted expected keys). Kept, which changes the protocol's 'no checkpoints kept' operational rule; disk is not a constraint. Features are extracted from the RELOADED checkpoint.
execution.feature_cache: one file per (row, seed, fold) with metadata: row, seed, fold, config sha256, checkpoint sha256, row-list sha256, base weights sha256, image-list sha256, precision. It is reused only if every field matches, and is otherwise refused.
execution.downstream: unchanged D1 recipe (synth_composition, fuse 1, normalise); packets strictly validated against research_r2.packets.fold_contract (ordered candidate ids, truth, shapes, finite)

fold_ok_only_if: every trainable tensor received a gradient at every checked step
every trainable tensor received a non-zero gradient at least once
checked global gradient norms are finite, except steps the AMP scaler skipped, which may be at most 5% of steps and never 3 checks in a row
frozen parameters are byte-identical after training
the checkpoint holds exactly the expected keys and reloads with max output difference 0.0
fail_closed.rows: a row is complete only when all six folds are ok. Evaluation refuses incomplete rows, and failures are recorded, never retried silently. A rerun writes a new attempt directory; earlier attempts are kept.

row_details.J4a: RandomResizedCrop(224, scale (0.6, 1.0), bicubic) + h-flip, then CLIP normalisation
row_details.J4b: ColorJitter(0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.05) + RandomGrayscale(0.1) + GaussianBlur(kernel 9, sigma 0.1-2.0, p 0.2) on the CLIP-resized centre crop, + h-flip (the parent's flip is kept)
row_details.J5: within-concept source-balanced per-sample loss weights (research_r2.methods.within_concept_source_weight), one vector for the crop CE and one for the disease CE, each normalised to mean 1 over the fitting rows, on top of the composition-balanced sampler
row_details.J6: 0.5 x supervised contrastive loss on the L2-normalised image embedding; positives = in-batch images with the same disease and a different crop; tau 0.1; anchors without a positive are excluded
row_details.J7: disease projection Pd = Linear(d, d); disease head on Pd(z); crop adversary Linear(d, n_crop) on GradReverse(Pd(z), lambda 0.1); crop head on z. Downstream features are z (the encoder embedding).
row_details.J8: ConvNeXt-B features[7] and the classifier LayerNorm trained; heads on the 1,024-d pooled feature; extraction = v3 torchvision extraction (fp32 weights, fp16 autocast, centre + h-flip). Downstream = D1 on [L2(v3 frozen CLIP-L/14), L2(fold ConvNeXt)], as F10. Reported against D1 (control) and F10.

execution.nested_parent_rule: in the nested estimate, for each held fold the J4a-J7 parent is recomputed on the other five folds. J4a-J7 rows are selectable in that held fold only if the inner parent equals the parent they were trained from; otherwise they are excluded there (recorded).
execution.three_seed_gate: each seed gets its own LOFO choice per fold; the gate is applied to the per-fold mean over seeds of H_bal, AUSUC and healthy shortcut. The nested estimate is computed per seed and averaged.

audit_before_training: synthetic six-fold dry run (tiny backbone, synthetic images, real folds) through train -> checkpoint -> reload -> extract -> D1 -> packets -> evaluation, monitoring that no official-test file and no image file is opened
J0 through the complete six-fold workflow on real data (no training): fold packets must equal the registered v3 D1 packets within 1e-5
J8 at zero epochs through the workflow: ConvNeXt fold features must equal the v3 tv_convnext_base features
a metric-free J1 smoke run (20 optimiser steps, pilot fold I6) through train -> checkpoint -> reload -> extract -> packet validation; its scores are never summarised
